launches.title: Salem Robotics - Autonomous robots for hazardous spaces
launches.tagline: We deploy robots to perform autonomous inspections and surveys in hazardous spaces, like nuclear.
launches.body:
We're [Caleb](https://www.linkedin.com/in/caleb-horan) and [Janak](https://www.linkedin.com/in/janak-panthi), PhD roboticists from UT Austin. We've spent a combined 15 years in nuclear, 10 of which deploying autonomous robots at Los Alamos National Lab, and we're building Salem Robotics.\
**TLDR:** Our software turns robots into independent survey and inspection workers at your facility.

[Launch Video](https://youtu.be/7xObOE6knZM)

## **Life and death pain worth $Millions/year**

At every nuclear facility, highly trained radiation-protection teams spend hours each day walking the site, filling out hand-drawn maps, and searching for something life-threatening: radiation. IN THE BEST CASE they find nothing, and still have to return to their posts to transcribe the data into a computer before doing the actual high-value work they were assigned. These surveys are time-consuming, dangerous, expensive, and prone to data inconsistencies that carry direct regulatory consequences.

The same pain exists well beyond nuclear. Whether it's gas-leak inspection or ammonia surveys, similar workflows run across oil, gas, chemical, biological, space, and other hazardous facilities.

## **What we do**

An operator defines the work from a simple dashboard; the robot then navigates the site, handles instruments, opens doors, turns valves, collects measurements, and generates structured, auditable, compliance-ready reports. We're hardware-agnostic, so plants run our software on robots they already own, many of which sit in a closet today as "$200k paperweights, " or we can provide the right robot for the job. Our stack is designed for safety-critical infrastructure and comes with theoretical safety guarantees, exactly what regulators and plant leadership require. Our core manipulation framework was not possible before and is based on **breakthrough founder research** published and presented at the most prestigious IEEE journals and conferences in the world. 

We're already in active contract-scoping conversations across the nuclear industry and oil & gas.

**Our asks**

* Intros to operations or innovation leaders in nuclear or similar hazardous sites (oil, gas, chem, bio, space).
* Advice from founders who've sold into safety-critical industrial environments.
* Sites where routine surveys are frequent, hard to staff, or particularly painful? We'd love to hear about them.
